set.request: ux/Auth: login, signup, password reset, social-login row as one behavioral class assembled from ui/ templates, responsive phone to 3440. Exemplar of ux/ hands-you-a-class-you-can-extend.
steps: read the contract: ux doc/system.md, ui/field ui/dialog ui/alert, code skill
build Auth.js: login/signup/reset views, switching, validation, social row
build page.js demo: live exemplar, words proof, source
set.outcome:
**Auth: login, signup, reset and a social row as one class - the first ux/ exemplar, extended and interaction-proven.**

- [Auth](/framework/ux/Auth/) - live card in a resizable stage, source open, words-proof band (ui-contrast ui-compact)
- [MagicAuth](/framework/ux/Auth/magic-auth/) - the named extension: 14 lines, 4 seams overridden, nothing else in Auth.js moves
- [doc/decisions.md](/framework/ux/Auth/doc/decisions/) - the five layout answers, the CSS, the named-extension verdict
- [readme.md](/framework/ux/Auth/readme.md)

![Create account, submitted empty: :user-invalid reddens every field, ui/alert carries the message](auth-validation.png)
![MagicAuth: the password field is gone, everything else is Auth's](auth-magic-extension.png)
![Both words at 3440 - the compact card measures 8px pad/gap against the default's 16px, probed not just eyeballed](auth-3440-words.png)

Verified headless: overflow_x 0 at 360/768/1280/3440, no console errors beyond the known LiveReload WebSocket noise, no .md-error on any of the four tabs.

Cut: real OAuth (brief rules it out - `social(provider)` is a bare seam), a password-strength meter, a remember-me checkbox - each is the same 'every real form wants a fourth thing' argument `ui/field/page.js` already makes for staying a template.
